name: secforge-mcp
description: SecForge - Autonomous Application Security, Threat Modeling, OWASP Hardening, Secrets Management & Incident Response Engine MCP. Threat-models your product, hardens OWASP Top 10 with vulnerable-vs-fixed code pairs (IDOR, injection, SSRF, auth failures), locks down secrets and supply chain (OIDC CI, lockfile discipline, leaked-secret runbooks), configures strict nonce-based CSP and security headers, and prepares SOC 2 / pentests / incident response.
author: AmyGraphics
